module counter_09 (
  input clk,
  input rst_n,
  output [7:0] lfsr_out
);

  reg [7:0] lfsr;

  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      lfsr <= 8'h01;
    end else begin
      reg bit_tap;
      bit_tap = lfsr[0] ^ lfsr[1] ^ lfsr[2] ^ lfsr[3] ^ lfsr[4];
      lfsr <= {bit_tap, lfsr[7:1]};
    end
  end

  assign lfsr_out = lfsr;

endmodule
